collection.description: A string of strange coincidences unsettles the village, and the village decides how to respond.

intro.name: The beginning
intro.text: A coconut falls exactly as an elder mentions falling fruit. A bird calls when a child predicts a bird call. A fire goes out when a storyteller speaks of darkness. Some laugh; others are unsettled.

a1.text: Everyone enjoys the coincidence and returns to work.

a2.text: A researcher dismisses the stories just as another extraordinary coincidence occurs.

a3.text: A child discovers a loose branch, familiar bird calls, and a gust of wind. The mystery dissolves.

b2.text: Wind and animal behavior account for them.

b3.text: All but one incident can be explained.

b4.text: Investigators find an overlooked spring, cave opening, or useful plant.

c1.text: The villagers prepare for disaster; nothing happens.

c2.text: Precautions accidentally protect stored food from an unrelated heavy rain.

text_only.reason: narrative: stored food is protected, not changed

c3.text: Rumors grow until someone insists Isola itself will vanish by sunset. It does not.

c4__fx.text: an actual strange phenomenon occurs. The researchers record it without claiming to understand it.

c4__text.text: an actual strange phenomenon occurs. The researchers record it without claiming to understand it.
